verse.verse_2: Because the blind man came unto him.
verse.verse_3: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)
verse.verse_4: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him?
verse.verse_5: As for him who thinketh himself independent,
verse.verse_7: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace).
verse.verse_8: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose
verse.verse_11: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,
verse.verse_12: So let whosoever will pay heed to it,
verse.verse_18: From what thing doth He create him?
verse.verse_19: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,
verse.verse_20: Then maketh the way easy for him,
verse.verse_21: Then causeth him to die, and burieth him;
verse.verse_22: Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life.
verse.verse_23: Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him.
verse.verse_25: How We pour water in showers
verse.verse_26: Then split the earth in clefts
verse.verse_27: And cause the grain to grow therein
verse.verse_32: Provision for you and your cattle.
verse.verse_34: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother
verse.verse_35: And his mother and his father
verse.verse_36: And his wife and his children,
verse.verse_37: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).
verse.verse_38: On that day faces will be bright as dawn,
verse.verse_40: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them,
verse.verse_42: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.
